notes: E2 navigation. Facts verified by grep at the pinned commit on 2026-11-09, before any agent run. from_str (de.rs:2709) builds a StrRead-backed Deserializer and calls from_trait, which runs T::deserialize against Deserializer and checks the end; deserialize_any dispatches on the next byte.
